roadmap.goal: Story #6055 — the Task Manager's Activity list names entities where it should name work. Two slices. Slice 01 (frontend only, no contract touched): every row leads with a verb — Refreshing / Forecasting / Removing — so a Portfolio refresh and the forecast it triggers stop drawing two rows with the same text; both lookups become exhaustive Record<UpdateTaskType, …> so a sixth update type is a compile error rather than a silent tenant of a default arm; the '(removal)' suffix is replaced, not joined. Slice 02 (backend + frontend): UpdateTaskResponse.WaitingBehind changes from string? to a nested WaitingBehindResponse(string Name, UpdateType UpdateType, bool IsSameEntity) per ADR-206; the backend decides sameness as (entity kind, id) and NEVER as id alone; the browser words it — same entity reads 'Queued behind its own refresh/forecast/removal', a different entity still reads 'Queued behind <name>'. Done when: every pending specification listed below is un-skipped and green, the five named existing specifications are updated rather than deleted and are green, `grep -n "string | IWaitingBehind" Lighthouse.Frontend/src/services/UpdateSubscriptionService.ts` returns zero matches, the backend suite (live-connector categories excluded) and `pnpm test` / `pnpm build` are green with zero warnings, and Stryker kill rate is >= 80% on both stacks for the touched surfaces.
roadmap.paradigm_note: The Hypothesis + state-delta unit mandate from nw-roadmap does not apply here and its omission is deliberate, not an oversight. DISTILL already recorded the resolution (feature-delta.md, DISTILL / Reconciliation): this repository is C# + NUnit 4.6 + Moq and TypeScript + Vitest + RTL; there is no pytest-bdd, no .feature file and no Hypothesis, and the ATDD policy records that the Python-pilot artifacts do not apply. The crafter authors NO tests in this story — all fifteen specifications were written by DISTILL and sit skipped. The crafter's RED phase is UN-SKIPPING them; its GREEN phase is production code. The only tests the crafter edits are the five existing green specifications named in the delta as breaking on purpose.

D5 — the queue stays one lane. Nothing here re-lands #5877's per-type lanes.
D7 — docs/settings/taskmanager.md's row-wording table matches what the component emits, and the page names forecasts.
OQ-2 settled at DISTILL — WaitingBehindResponse.UpdateType is sent in BOTH cases, not only the self-reference. A payload whose shape depends on its own contents buys nothing.

They shipped 2026-09-19 and were reverted the same day for destroying Feature ownership under concurrent refreshes. No step here re-lands them, reintroduces those types, or depends on lanes existing. The queue is one lane in, one lane out, and D4's rule holds either way.
Collapsing the refresh row and the forecast row into one — rejected 2026-09-21. Two pieces of work are two rows.
The stop button's `Stop refreshing <name>` label, including on a removal row.
